title: Resistors: color bands, tolerance, and calculations

spans.text: A resistor limits current, divides voltage, and sets a stable input level. In a four-band code, the first two bands are digits, the third is a multiplier, and the last is tolerance.

spans.caption: Resistors: color bands, tolerance, and calculations

spans.text: Yellow–violet–red–gold: 47 × 100 = 4700 Ω, tolerance ±5%. LED resistor: R = (supply voltage − LED drop) / current.
